entries.title: Your iPhone and iPad show every choice on a request to use a secret
entries.body: When a task asks to use one of your saved secrets, your phone now shows the same choices as your computer: Allow once, Don't allow, and Always allow this or Allow for 10 minutes. Before, a phone not set up to approve secret uses showed only Don't allow, and no phone showed Always allow this. Tapping a choice the phone cannot make says where to make it: Allow once asks you to turn on Approves secret uses in Settings first, and the lasting choices are made on your computer.

picture.alt: A request to use a secret on an iPhone not set up to approve, with Allow for 10 minutes under the note and Don't allow and Allow once below it
